pillars.description: Speak with technical depth and credibility without bragging or belittling others.
pillars.dos: State verified achievements, cite audited metrics, highlight robust engineering.
pillars.donts: Do not use hyperbole like 'crushes competitors', 'unbeatable', or 'the undisputed king'.

pillars.description: Treat creators as partners; educate and elevate rather than dictate.
pillars.dos: Use inclusive pronouns, supportive guidance, and clear explanations.
pillars.donts: Never use dismissive or punitive words like 'forbidden', 'idiotic', or 'rejected without appeal'.

pillars.description: Be honest about AI capabilities, privacy boundaries, and factual evidence.
pillars.dos: Clearly disclose AI assistance, cite approved sources, maintain modesty.
pillars.donts: Never claim '100% infallible', 'zero-defect guarantee', or unproven magical outcomes.

prohibited_terms.reason: Violates Brand Tone Pillar 1 (Non-aggressive, respectful positioning).
Cheap devalues the brand image and implies low quality.
Absolute superlatives are legally risky and technologically inaccurate.
Unsupported promotional ROI guarantees violate FTC and ASCI advertising regulations.
prohibited_terms.suggestion: proven up to 10x in verified customer case studies

prohibited_terms.reason: Hype-driven marketing cliches degrade engineering credibility.
Incorrect brand casing. Must always have a space between Inkloom and AI.
Product brand must be written as single compound 'AegisBrand' followed by OS or AI.

disallowed_colors.reason: Neon Magenta clashes with brand trust spectrum
Pure yellow fails WCAG AA 4.5:1 text contrast
